import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_69/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_69/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# According to operation_history: JOIN on ["city", "city"]
# Join df0 and df1 on the "city" column (inner join by default)
df_joined = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="city", how="inner")

# Reorder and cast columns to match target schema:
# Target Schema: ['city': string, 'driver_count': integer, 'type': string, 'date': string, 'fare': float, 'ride_id': integer]

# Ensure correct dtypes:
df_joined['city'] = df_joined['city'].astype(str)
df_joined['driver_count'] = df_joined['driver_count'].astype(int)
df_joined['type'] = df_joined['type'].astype(str)
df_joined['date'] = df_joined['date'].astype(str)
df_joined['fare'] = df_joined['fare'].astype(float)
# ride_id might be large integer, ensure integer type (int64)
df_joined['ride_id'] = df_joined['ride_id'].astype('int64')

# Select and order columns as per target schema
df_target = df_joined[['city', 'driver_count', 'type', 'date', 'fare', 'ride_id']]

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_69/target_multisource.csv"
df_target.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_69/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_69/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Perform inner join on 'city'
result = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="city", how="inner")

# Ensure column order and types match target schema exactly

# Convert ride_id to integer if not already (in case of float)
